notes: Rjukan, Telemark (Vestfold og Telemark): hydro-powered facility in the 'cradle of hydropower', online since 2014 (7.5 MW base); campus expanded with 13,000 sqm addition at Svaddevegen; waste-heat reuse to Hima Seafood trout farm; Volkswagen Group anchor tenant. ~77 staff (~10+ per MW). Green Mountain group holds ~644.5 MW reserved and is queued for ~485 MW more in Norway (NRK).
